public.README.md:
# Repair component-prefix selection

Return input paths whose slash-separated components have the requested prefix. Remove repeated slash separators and leading/trailing slashes before comparison. Preserve original matching strings and input order. Empty normalized prefix matches all paths. Do not treat a partial component as a match. Do not resolve dot components.

The CLI accepts one JSON array argument and returns the corresponding JSON result array. Preserve the original public tests, CLI, and README. Add a new discovered regression test without changing original test bytes. Run the exact public verification command read-only after your final edit: `go test ./...`. No external dependencies are needed.
